title: Sep 30 Results + Oct 1 Preview: Split Decision, But the Braves Get Another Shot
summary: We went 2-2 on Sep 30, but here's the thing—tomorrow's a new chance with Atlanta.

content.value:
## Here's The Thing About Split Days

So Sep 30 gave us a perfectly balanced 2-2 record, and honestly? That's baseball for you. Some days the model clicks, some days it humbles you. We had high confidence in a couple of picks that didn't pan out, but we also caught some wins where it mattered.

## What Went Right (And Wrong)

The Padres and Yankees came through for us—no surprises there. But both the Braves and Astros, our 62% confidence plays, didn't deliver. That stings a little, especially when you're banking on the higher probability picks.

But here's what I love about this job: every day is a fresh start. The data doesn't hold grudges, and neither should we.

## Tomorrow's Top Pick: Running It Back With Atlanta

And speaking of fresh starts—the Braves get another crack at the Phillies on Oct 1. Same matchup, new opportunity. Our model likes Atlanta at 61% with Brent Suter on the mound facing Zack Wheeler.

Is it bold to go right back to the well after a miss? Maybe. But the numbers are the numbers, and sometimes you've got to trust the process even when yesterday didn't go your way.

content.title: ⭐ Oct 1 Top Pick
content.sub: 61% win probability · Suter vs Wheeler · Home field advantage

content.value:
## The Bottom Line

A .500 day isn't what we're shooting for, but it's part of the journey. The model stays consistent, we stay analytical, and we come back tomorrow ready to capture value where we see it.

The Braves-Phillies rematch is our top play for Oct 1. Let's see if Atlanta can flip the script.

*See you tomorrow with the results.* ⚾

author: Hana
